name: Osananajimi ga Dosukebe Kawaii
original_name: 幼馴染がドスケベカワイイ
source:

with a childhood friend who can't control himself when in heat.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE233230.html]DLsite English[/url]]
